title: SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon image animation must keep the scene fixed while natural material (e.g., water, smoke, or fire) continues to move. Autoregressive video generators read recent frames for temporal continuity, but this history also carries accumulated appearance errors, and sparsifying it disrupts motion. We introduce SceneTether, a training-free attention-read policy that keeps where attention reads recent memory but changes what appearance that memory returns. SceneTether keeps every key of the newest latent, blends its low-activity values toward co-located source-image values, and leaves high-activity values untouched so motion can evolve; an activity map estimated from the first generated latents and then frozen decides where to blend. It adds no denoising evaluations and leaves the cache-update rule unchanged. On a Causal Forcing++ generator, SceneTether raises source-support PSNR by 5.15 dB over its framewise Echo host across two seeds

translated_title: SceneTether：面向长时程自回归图像动画的活动门控数值锚定方法
translated_abstract: 长时程图像动画需要在自然物质（如水、烟或火）持续运动的同时保持场景固定不变。自回归视频生成器通过读取近期帧来保证时间连续性，但这些历史帧也会携带累积的外观误差，而对其历史进行稀疏化处理又会破坏运动。我们提出了SceneTether，这是一种无需训练的注意力读取策略，它保持注意力读取近期记忆的位置不变，但改变该记忆所返回的外观内容。SceneTether保留最新潜变量的所有键，将其低活动度的数值向同位置的源图像数值进行混合，而保持高活动度数值不变以使运动得以演化；混合位置由一张从首次生成的潜变量中估计并随后冻结的活动图来决定。该方法不增加任何额外的去噪评估，且不改变缓存更新规则。在Causal Forcing++生成器上，SceneTether在两个随机种子下相比其逐帧Echo宿主模型将源支持PSNR提升了5.15 dB。
tldr: SceneTether是一种无需训练的注意力读取策略，通过冻结的活动图将低活动区域的潜变量数值锚定回源图像数值，在长时程自回归图像动画中消除累积外观误差的同时保持自然物质的自由运动。
en_tdlr: SceneTether is a training-free attention-read policy that anchors low-activity latent values to co-located source-image values via a frozen activity map, eliminating accumulated appearance errors while preserving natural material motion in long-horizon autoregressive image animation.
